newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shun Tak unit revolver increased 80 pct.
newsitem.headline: Shun Tak unit revolver increased 80 pct.

text.p: The three-year revolving credit facility for Shun Tak Finance has been increased to HK$1.8 billion from HK$1.0 billion because of oversubscription, arranger BNP Hong Kong said on Tuesday.

The facility, guaranteed by Shun Tak Holdings Ltd, pays a margin of 95 basis points over the Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate. With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 108.33 basis points.
Others arrangers are Commerz (East Asia) and WestLB Hong Kong. Some 23 other banks have joined the syndication.
